$comment: Part II Section A — XML mapping for the economic operator identity, into UBL cac:EconomicOperatorParty of the ESPD RESPONSE document. Field set is the Schematron-mandated minimum (BR-RESP-10-02..07). The role is a child of cac:EconomicOperatorRole; name/size/identifier/country are on the nested cac:Party. Codelist attribute sets expand via expandCodelistAttributes (eo-role-type, economic-operator-size, country). The EO identifier carries @schemeAgencyID (BR-OTH-02, fatal).

rules.$comment: BR-RESP-10-02/03 (error) — the EO's role, on EconomicOperatorRole/RoleCode (eo-role-type).
BR-RESP-10-05 (error) — official name of the EO.
BR-RESP-10-07 (error) — country of the EO, bare Country code with the country codelist attributes.
BR-RESP-10-04 (error) — EO identifier, with its scheme agency on @schemeAgencyID (BR-OTH-02, fatal). No @schemeID/EOIDType on the EO identifier in the Response sample.
